heading.selfIssued: Sign in with a self-issued ID
sub.enrol: Your wallet will be asked for a self-issued ID Token (SIOPv2), signed with its own key. That key is then enrolled for you, and signs you in here from then on.
sub.selfIssued: Your wallet will be asked for a self-issued ID Token (SIOPv2), signed with a key you enrolled here.
sub.wallet: Your wallet will be asked for a credential this service issued to you, and shown exactly what is asked for before anything is sent.
sub.walletSecondFactor: Your wallet will be asked for a credential this service issued to you, and shown exactly what is asked for before anything is sent. It is your second factor: the credential must be yours.
wait.dcButton: Use a wallet on this or a nearby device
wait.dcMissing: This browser has no Digital Credentials API, so it cannot ask a wallet directly. Use the link below.
wait.dcMissingQr: This browser has no Digital Credentials API, so it cannot ask a wallet directly. Use the link below, or the QR code.
wait.noscript: Scripts are off, so the button above cannot reach a wallet; the link below needs none.
wait.qrLinkNote: for a wallet that cannot be reached through this browser. Only use it for your own phone: a QR code can be passed to somebody else, and whoever scans it signs THIS browser in.
wait.notBack: If your wallet on this device does not bring you back,
sameDevice.open: Open your wallet on this device
fallback.nothing: Nothing is waiting for this sign-in, so there is nothing to go back to. Start from the application you were signing in to.
fallback.stillWaiting: the request that sent you here is still waiting.
qr.heading: Scan with your wallet
qr.warning: Only scan this with your own phone. Whoever scans it signs THIS browser in, so a code somebody else showed you is a way for them to sign in as you.
qr.waiting: Waiting for your wallet — this page checks again every {poll} seconds, and the request expires in {seconds} seconds.
